{{Top|leg}}
A '''Dairkan Starliner''' was a type of [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] that was in use around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].

A notable example was the ''[[Jewel of Churba]]'', which had accommodations for passengers to travel in unparalleled luxury on the starliner's upper decks.<ref name="X-Wing">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>
For example, a spiral docking port and shuttles were available to ultra-class passengers who wanted to avoid waiting to disembark with the other passengers.
